subject: Request: Short extension + sandbox credit to accommodate integration blocker
content:
From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@fluxcart.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@fluxcart.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Integration blocker — asking for a short extension + sandbox padding

Hi Tessa,

Quick status update from our side: while wiring up FluxCart's product taxonomy into Redwood's embedding pipeline we ran into an upstream SDK regression in the payments gateway that is blocking our test harness. Our engineers are on it but estimate ~10 business days before the fix lands and we can re-run the end-to-end tests.

Because our pilot trial window is scheduled to close next week, we're worried we'll lose momentum if we have to restart the onboarding from scratch. Could Redwood approve a 30-day extension on the pilot and a one-time sandbox top-up (around 50k token units) so we can hit the demo milestone once the integration is fixed?

Attached: integration_log.txt (excerpt of failing calls).

We appreciate any runway you can provide — will share ETA updates as we make progress.

Thanks,
Oliver Reed
Head of Platform Integrations
FluxCart

---
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@fluxcart.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration blocker — asking for a short extension + sandbox padding

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the log. Sorry to hear about the SDK regression; I can imagine how frustrating that is.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I've looped in Dev (solutions engineering) and Markus (sales lead) to coordinate an approval.
- Could you share a short timeline for the 10 business days (are there specific checkpoints we should expect)?
- If you have a minimal repro or the failing curl snippet, please drop it in the thread — will help our SEs triage in parallel.

I will submit an internal request for a 30-day trial extension and a sandbox credit top-up. Can you confirm the exact amount you'd like (50k token units is fine as a starting point), and whether you need the credits to be consumable only against the pilot model?

I'll follow up once I have an approval path.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales Rep
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (blank MAP template)

---
From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: recommended extension and credit amount for FLX-7832

Internal note (do not share with customer):
- Reviewed Oliver's log; root cause looks like a version mismatch plus a missing timeout on the 3rd-party gateway. Engineering estimates ~7–12 business days depending on their patch cycle.
- Recommendation: approve 30 days extension + 45,000 sandbox tokens (restricted to pilot model) rather than full 50k. That keeps runway reasonable but requires a clear MAP deliverable before additional credits.
- Proposed MAP items to tie to the extension: (1) integration fix verified by FluxCart engineering in staging, (2) one joint demo scheduled, (3) sign-off on SOW-v1.1.

I'll draft the MAP and SOW changes; Markus, do you want me to open a Jira INTG ticket for tracking and link HubSpot?

— Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@fluxcart.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration blocker — asking for a short extension + sandbox padding

Oliver / Nadia — thanks for outlining the issue and for sharing the log. We can do the following as an interim accommodation to keep momentum on the pilot:

1) Grant a 30-calendar-day extension to your pilot window (new close date: 2026-12-01).
2) Provision 45,000 sandbox tokens scoped to the pilot model.
3) Attach a short MAP: staging verification, joint demo, and SOW sign-off before any further credits.

I've attached an updated SOW (SOW-v1.1.pdf) with the adjusted timeline and a DocuSign placeholder (we'll send the envelope once you confirm). Once you confirm acceptance of the terms we will apply the credits and update the HubSpot deal (FLX-7832).

Next steps for FluxCart: share the expected patch ETA and preferred demo windows.

If it helps, Dev will stand by for a quick remote debug session tomorrow between 09:00–13:00 PT.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-v1.1.pdf
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FLX-7832

---
From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@fluxcart.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@fluxcart.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration blocker — asking for a short extension + sandbox padding

Markus / Tessa,

Thank you — that is exactly what we needed. We accept the 30-day extension and the 45,000 sandbox tokens scoped to the pilot model. Our engineering team just confirmed the gateway vendor has a hotfix scheduled for Thursday (2026-11-12) and we should be able to validate staging by Monday (2026-11-15).

We'll aim for a joint demo the week of 11/16 — Nadia and I will share preferred times today. Also attaching the minimal reproduce steps in a follow-up note.

Appreciate your quick help on this — keeps our internal stakeholders aligned.

Best,
Oliver Reed
Head of Platform Integrations
FluxCart

Attachment: integration_log.txt (updated excerpt)
